description: S45 T4 (PM7.3): an authoring write whose peer cannot be resolved is REFUSED, never stamped with a placeholder. The daemon's peer credential answers uid 0 for an unattributable connection (T0 item 3.4); stamping the audit "user 0" would dress an unattributable widening of a guard in a real-looking identity, so the door stops before params are even read and answers ErrPolicyNoActor. The actor is the kernel's, never a claim: params carrying actor/status/createdBy are refused as the shape error (-32602) by the door's strict key check, and no params content can replace what this fixture's refusal says is missing.

error.message: no actor for a policy authoring write

data.what: the authoring write needs a person, and this connection resolved to no peer identity (uid 0) — or the runtime wired no actor stamp at all
data.means: the actor comes from the connection's peer credential, never from params, and an unresolvable peer is refused rather than stamped with a placeholder — an unattributed policy write is the audit row that cannot name who changed a guard
data.todo: write from a connection the daemon can attribute to a peer (the peer credential, not a claim); params never carry the actor — an actor key is refused as a shape error
